description: A waterfront residence at Rosie Bay near Tofino, on Vancouver Island's outer coast. Cast-in-place concrete and clear fir meet floor-to-ceiling glazing beneath warm wood ceilings; a double-sided concrete fireplace divides the living and dining rooms, and the kitchen is fitted in fir millwork with stone counters.
The photographs survive in the studio's archive, dated 2005.
note: Gallery recovered from the studio's original website via the Internet Archive.
